scope.method: Exact committed fix and surrounding reporting path read; two focused source-bound tests independently executed; existing owner source/report binding hashes verified.
scope.independence: Reviewer authored CI4 finding, not its implementation or tests. Only this follow-up artifact is changed.

paths.review_scope: Narrow CI4 closure: flag marks completion of the with-body; teardown-only OSError becomes explicit failed report while original nonzero command code remains. Setup/body OSError is rethrown. Report write follows handled teardown.
Read and independently execute both added regressions: three actual finite command cases preserve pass/failure/timeout evidence after injected teardown error; setup OSError remains visible.

Unchanged workflow dependency closure only: corrected runner now publishes completed command reports after handled environment teardown errors when report destination is writable. No native CI execution claim.

closed_findings.closure: After the body completes, environment teardown OSError is retained as sanitized top-level cleanup_errors and report status fail. A prior successful command produces overall1; failed command7 and timeout124 retain their codes. Completed command status/output remains in the written JSON. Errors before teardown are not misclassified or swallowed.

independent_execution.method: Compile exact git-show module bytes under module names; run only the two named unittest cases. Teardown test contains three subtests with actual finite child processes and a cleanup-only PermissionError injection.
independent_execution.setup_error: Propagates PermissionError with original setup diagnostic; not labeled teardown.

owner_execution_evidence.scope_note: Existing owner52-pass scripts run, with explicit binding for the two changed runner/test sources and report bytes, inspected but not independently rerun in full. Other sources selected by script discovery are not individually bound by that owner sidecar.

limitations: No broad suite, native Windows fault, live request or GitHub matrix run was performed by this review. Finite fault injection verifies the exception/report path on macOS.
This closure assumes the report destination itself is writable. It does not guarantee report publication after report I/O failures, abrupt process termination, or unbounded OS filesystem cleanup.
A cleanup diagnostic records incomplete environment cleanup; it is not a claim that residual files or descendants were removed. Existing CI3 process-tree cleanup limits remain explicit.

The fix intentionally handles only OSError after body completion. Setup/execution errors before that point retain their original exception behavior; this review does not expand the reporting contract for unrelated exceptions.
Prior CI1–CI3 closure and CI4 finding artifacts are preserved unchanged. Release readiness, live behavior and native platform acceptance remain outside this source/offline closure.
